fields.sections.0.h: Genie 4's Core Innovation: Multimodal Real-Time Simulation
fields.sections.1.h: Real-Time World Evolution Based on User Input
fields.sections.2.h: Breakthrough Progress in Physics Simulation and Human Behavior
fields.sections.3.h: Innovation in Native Audio Generation and Interactive Conversation
fields.sections.5.h: Research Preview and Phased Rollout Plan
fields.sections.0.ko: Google DeepMind's Genie 4 transcends existing world models to achieve unprecedented levels of realism and real-time interactivity. The model's defining feature is its native multimodal capability: audio such as music, ambient sound, and dialogue is generated simultaneously with the simulated world. By integrating the capabilities of Gemini family models like Gemini Omni to realize convincing appearance and behavior, it maintains simulation consistency through the complex reasoning abilities of other Gemini models.
fields.sections.1.ko: Genie 4 simulates what happens next when a user sets an initial scene. It predicts how the world responds, what sounds it makes, how people move, react, and speak. Through natural language, users can manipulate changes in real time—such as weather modifications, camera movement, and introduction of new characters or objects. Gemini adapts user prompts to match the context of the surrounding environment. Between user inputs, the model actively monitors and steers the scene to ensure the world progresses coherently.
fields.sections.2.ko: Genie 4 establishes new standards of realism in real-time interactive simulation. Based on advanced physics understanding, it simulates real-world physical scenarios such as aerodynamics and collisions. The most groundbreaking progress appears in how human characters are represented. It generates characters that move naturally, respond organically to their environment, and can be manipulated interactively in real time.
fields.sections.3.ko: Genie 4 is the first real-time world model to generate audio natively. From wind through trees to waves on a beach, each world features ambient sound suited to its environment. More importantly is the frontier of human voice. Genie 4 introduces interactive dialogue capabilities that adapt in real time. Characters converse and respond to user input or world events, all happening in real time.
fields.sections.4.ko: The ability to understand and simulate worlds is a core element of artificial general intelligence development. Genie 4 has elevated the capability to build safe simulation environments while generating infinite variables. This opens broad application possibilities, from developing training environments for robots and agents to creating new interactive experiences.
fields.sections.5.ko: Genie 4 is currently rolling out in a research preview phase targeted at trusted testers. After collecting feedback, it will gradually open to general consumers and developers. Plans include prioritizing support for Google AI Ultra subscribers and early access partners in Gemini API and Google AI Studio.
fields.caveat: The source text is a technology announcement blog post and thus includes product marketing claims. Mentions of limitations in actual deployment stages and ethical considerations are limited.
